notes: Greedy vertex coloring with CN and DSATUR heuristics, plus three coloring validators. Lazy-deletion BinaryHeap avoids custom indexed-heap data structure. CN mirrors igraph_i_vertex_coloring_greedy_cn (1-based internal colors). DSATUR mirrors igraph_i_vertex_coloring_dsatur (0-based colors, saturation+degree priority). Validators: is_vertex_coloring, is_bipartite_coloring (with directed edge-direction detection), is_edge_coloring. All handle self-loops, multi-edges, directed graphs. Reference: coloring.c 519 lines.
